description.value: Everest Indian & Nepalese Restaurant is a family-owned, licensed fine dining establishment in West Kelowna, BC, run by owner Ram Sapkota who immigrated from Nepal in 2007 and trained as a chef across Europe. The restaurant serves an extensive menu of authentic Indian and Nepalese cuisine—from tandoori specialties and Nepalese meals to fusion dishes—and has accumulated over 200 five-star Google reviews. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery with an online ordering option make it a flexible stop for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, open restaurant at 1–2430 Main Street, West Kelowna, matching the OSM address. The primary phone number (250) 768-8700 is confirmed by the website, though two additional numbers appear there that are absent from OSM. Takeout and delivery are explicitly advertised; a dedicated Vegetarian Dishes menu section and a customer review citing 'Lots of vegan/vegetarian options' confirm that amenity, and the menu page notes all soups and salads are gluten free. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website lists two additional phone numbers not in OSM: (778) 754-7656 and (250) 863-5270. OSM only captures the primary number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a fully functioning website, confirmed address, extensive menu, and strong community presence. Straightforward inclusion.
